_original_lore: This skittish plant bolts the moment
you get too close, disappearing into
the ground. You'll need to figure out
how to get near without scaring it off.
name: 惊逃藤

source: This skittish plant bolts the moment
you get too close, disappearing into
the ground. You'll need to figure out
how to get near without scaring it off.
loreParagraphs.translation: 这种胆小的植物在你靠得太近的瞬间就会窜走,钻入地下.你需要想办法在不惊动它的情况下靠近.
